description: appsec-auditor guardrails, read tracking, and coverage gate. All inert unless <repo>/.appsec-audit/.active exists. Each hook runs through a small POSIX shell launcher that picks the first of python3, python, or py -3 that is Python 3.12 or newer, and does nothing if there is none.

hooks.command: for p in python3 python "py -3"; do if $p -I -S -c "import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 12))" >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec $p -I "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard.py"; fi; done; exit 0
for p in python3 python "py -3"; do if $p -I -S -c "import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 12))" >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec $p -I "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/track.py"; fi; done; exit 0
for p in python3 python "py -3"; do if $p -I -S -c "import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 12))" >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec $p -I "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/gate.py"; fi; done; exit 0
